University (جامعة دولة الأغنياء), مطعم البحر, street trees/palms, water shader and textures
(plank, windows, book shelves, signs, clock) are procedural three.js geometry / canvas
textures made for this project — no third-party models or images.
Arabic signs use the Cairo font already bundled in assets/fonts (SIL OFL 1.1).
